text:
By Data Skrive ,
2 hours ago
In the first of a three-game series, on Friday, May 22 at 9:38 p.m. ET, the Los Angeles Angels will host the Texas Rangers.
Angels vs. Rangers Series Info Rangers @ Angels Time: Friday, May 22 at 9:38 p.m. ET Angels Starting Pitcher: Grayson Rodriguez Rangers Starting Pitcher: Jacob deGrom TV Channel : ABTV and CW33 Livestream: Fubo Rangers @ Angels Time: Saturday, May 23 at 10:05 p.m. ET Angels Starting Pitcher: Walbert Urena Rangers Starting Pitcher: Nathan Eovaldi TV Channel : ABTV and RSN Livestream: Fubo Rangers @ Angels Time: Sunday, May 24 at 7:20 p.m. ET Angels Starting Pitcher: Reid Detmers Rangers Starting Pitcher: MacKenzie Gore TV Channel : Peacock Livestream: Fubo How to Bet on Angels vs. Rangers Games Angels vs. Rangers Betting Insights The Angels have been the moneyline favorite seven total times this season. They’ve gone 2-5 in those games. Los Angeles has won 13, or 35.1%, of the 37 games it has played as the underdog this season. The Rangers are 11-9 in games they were listed as the moneyline favorite (winning 55% of those games). Texas has entered the game as underdogs 27 times this season and won 12, or 44.4%, of those games.
